scope: Independent source-only peer review of EXT-D-0053/0054 commits 0b66b853, 33f7a921, and 1b8e9c06 against complete, accurate Showcase/Data/shared export
verification: Source and test inspection only. Resource admission refused; no tests, build, browser, clipboard, spreadsheet, install, or mutation proof executed. This is not native acceptance.

A_outcome.verdict: Original D53 long-string and D54 tab/newline/header losses are repaired in source, but complete export is not runtime-verified and error feedback is misleading.
evidence: src/lib/clipboard/copy.ts:115-130 no longer truncates strings in JSON; unsupported top-level JSON, cycles, and BigInt throw rather than returning a success-looking substitute.
src/lib/clipboard/copy.ts:169-186 quotes TSV headers and cells with tabs, CR, LF, or quotes and doubles embedded quotes.

src/features/showcase/components/ResultPreview.tsx:62-86 passes unsliced rows to JSON, TSV, and AI copy; src/features/showcase/tabs/PatternsTab.tsx:129-152,261-267 passes the saved-run rows to that preview; src/features/data/DataView.tsx:228-236,493-527 uses the same formatters on manual rerun.

JSON-compatible saved rows are the supported losslessness scope. Standard JSON.stringify still omits undefined object fields, changes non-finite numbers to null, and honors toJSON; the source-only review cannot establish a universal input contract.

finding.fact: handleClick stores either a clipboard failure string or a preparation failure string in copiedLabel. Both the single-option and popover triggers render a green Check whenever copiedLabel is truthy, and neither renders the failure text. Thus a cyclic/BigInt JSON or a failed clipboard write appears as a successful copy, directly contradicting the new truthful-failure behavior. The menu remains open for multi-option failure, but its trigger still shows the green check.
finding.repair: Represent success and failure separately in CopyMenu state; render a visible error message or red failure icon with an accessible label, and retain the success check only after a completed clipboard write. Cover both one-option and multi-option modes.

B_quality.verdict: Formatter tests use parse/round-trip assertions and a worked TSV literal, but no exercised red/green or UI proof exists.
evidence: tests/unit/clipboard-export.test.ts tests two distinct long values through JSON.parse and fenced AI JSON parse, so it is stronger than checking a truncation marker or formatter implementation text.
The TSV test compares to an explicit expected string and also parses the result with an independent test reader, including distinct tab-vs-space values and a tab-containing header.

The tests invoke formatters only; none exercises CopyMenu failure state, actual clipboard contents, spreadsheet paste, or the Showcase/Data result controls. The worker report explicitly records tests and mutation checks as unexecuted.
B_quality.missing_runtime: Focused tests, type check, installed extension copy from saved replay and Data manual rerun, exact clipboard reads, spreadsheet paste, and independent native verification remain outstanding.
